entries.en: (Error)
Hahaha, sorry fer doin' this to yer[n]teammate...
You'll grant this old man's wish,[n]wontcha? I'd loooove a shiny[n][f 2 5 3 9999 3].
Looks like yer precious teammate's in a[n]pinch... If you give me [var 0][n]yen, I might help you out.
You wanna save yer teammate, right?[n]Then let me have a sip of yer health.
Yer teammate's barely hanging on...[n]Give me some of yer stamina, and[n]I'll do somethin' about it.
Fine, you win.
I can't meet your demands.
Call Thieves Guild ([var 5] left).
[clr 2]You're up, Panther.[clr 27]
You know, I'm greedier than I look.
What a cheap price to pay for yer[n]teammate, yeah? This time, give me[n]one [f 2 5 3 9999 3].
...This ain't nearly enough fer me.
Give me [var 0] yen too.[n]Don't you want to save yer teammate?
...Yer so young. Makes me wanna toy[n]with you a little more.
Give me yer health this time. It's not[n]too much ta ask fer yer teammate, yeah?
...Yer young, so I'm sure you can give this[n]old man a bit more.
Give me yer stamina this time.[n]Experience is everything in this[n]world, after all.
...All right, I'll release yer teammate.[n]Good effort, sonny.
...Have you learned yer lesson? Guess[n]I'll give you back yer teammate, now.
Yer just gonna abandon yer teammate?[n]Very well. I'll grant yer wish, sonny—[n]say goodbye!
I get it. Know that you only got yerself[n]to blame if yer teammate hates you[n]fer this...
You don't care about yer teammate's[n]life... Seems yer not so different from[n]us Shadows, sonny.
Okay, I'm done playing with you, sonny.[n]Do what you want from here...
Sonny... you mean to tell me you don't[n]care about yer teammate?
...I see, I guess times have changed.[n]It's time fer this old man ta leave.[n]See ya...
See ya!
Luck's on yer side, sonny. Well then...[n]see ya!
...Now, let's continue where we left off.[n]Put up yer dukes!
...Well then, let's get back ta business.[n]You haven't forgotten, right?
Who the hell... Where'd those shots[n]come from!?
Nngh! Are there others!?
H-Hey, stop cryin'! ...Fine, I'll let you go,[n]just give me [f 2 5 3 9999 3].
I can't be seen makin' a lady cry.[n]I'll look the other way if you give me[n][var 0] yen!
How shameless... Calm down, young[n]lady. I'll let them go if I can have some[n]of yer health.
So noisy! Stop givin' me trouble![n]Give me some of yer stamina and[n]stop yer wailin'.
I-I didn't intend on makin' a girl cry...[n]Fine, I'm done here! I'm leaving!
Yikes... It's ungentlemanlike ta make[n]a lady cry. Today's just not my day...[n]I'm leavin'.
You don't even have one?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No... How could you take that from us?
Another band of thieves[n]responded to the call!
